name: Pakistan Affairs · Economy, Industry & Infrastructure
title: Pakistan Affairs · Economy, Industry & Infrastructure
subtitle: Practice bank topic · 29 MCQs
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Keys were cross-checked and corrected where needed; items marked Low confidence are noted in the explanation.
source: https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies (topic chapters: history, constitution, geography, economy, foreign relations, culture)
Key checks: na.gov.pk / Constitution Art. 51 (NA seats), Wikipedia & Gazette of India 17 Aug 1947 (Radcliffe Award), cabinet.gov.pk 1958 cabinet list (Bhutto as Commerce Minister)

questions.text: Cotton textile, the largest industry of Pakistan employ industrial labour force of magnitude of ____?
questions.explanation: Answer: 40%. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Quaid-e-Azam Solar Park is located near ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Bahawalpur. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Karachi Nuclear Power Plant was inaugurated on _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 28 Nov, 1972. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: Pakistan and Qatar signed a long term liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply agreement on _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: February 10, 2016. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: Karez is the irrigation system of which province of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Karez is an ancient underground irrigation system found in Balochistan, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/agriculture-irrigation-system) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: _ is the most prominent example of Rabi crop.
questions.explanation: Wheat is the most prominent example of a Rabi crop in Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/agriculture-irrigation-system).

questions.text: The mainstay of Pakistan's economy is:
questions.explanation: The mainstay of Pakistan's economy is Agriculture. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/agriculture-irrigation-system).

questions.text: Which is the most important staple food of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The most important staple food of Pakistan is Wheat. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/agriculture-irrigation-system).

questions.text: China Pakistan Economic Corridor will be fully operational by _?
questions.explanation: China Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) is planned to be fully operational by 2030. Low confidence: refers to the CPEC Long-Term Plan horizon of 2030. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/cpec-infrastructure-projects).

questions.text: CPEC is a part of which larger initiative?

options.C: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)

questions.explanation: CPEC is a part of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/cpec-infrastructure-projects).

questions.text: Under the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC), China is investing approximately on different projects in Pakistan over a period of the next six years.
questions.explanation: Under CPEC, China committed an investment of approximately US $46 billion in Pakistan over a period of six years. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/cpec-infrastructure-projects).

questions.text: In December 2022, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif laid foundation of Sukkur-Hyderabad motorway.
questions.explanation: In December 2022, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif laid the foundation of the 306 km Sukkur-Hyderabad motorway. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/cpec-infrastructure-projects).

questions.text: Which sector is the largest contributor to Pakistan's GDP?
questions.explanation: The Services sector is the largest contributor to Pakistan's GDP, accounting for over 50% of the total. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What is the total outlay of the Pakistan Budget 2024-25?
questions.explanation: The total outlay of the Pakistan Budget 2024-25 is Rs 18.877 trillion. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: How many five-year plans of Pakistan were announced till 2000?
questions.explanation: Pakistan announced a total of eight five-year plans till the year 2000. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Pakistan's First Five-Year Plan covered which period?
questions.explanation: Pakistan's first investment plan was the 1955-1960 First Five-Year Plan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Pakistan launched which program to boost economic sector for the period from 2024 to 2029?
questions.explanation: Pakistan launched the Uraan Pakistan program to boost its economic sector for the period from 2024 to 2029. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans).

questions.text: The Fifth Five-Year Plan of Pakistan was implemented during which years?
questions.explanation: The Fifth Five-Year Plan of Pakistan was implemented during 1978-1983. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans).

questions.text: To speed up economic growth, which plan was started in 1960?
questions.explanation: The 2nd Five Year Plan was launched in 1960 to accelerate Pakistan's economic growth. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans).

questions.text: The Twelfth Five-Year Plan of Pakistan was set for which period?
questions.explanation: The Twelfth Five-Year Plan of Pakistan was set for the period 2018-2023. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/economic-surveys-five-year-plans).

questions.text: Saindak project is producing copper, silver, and gold with the help/collaboration of which country?
questions.explanation: The Saindak project is producing copper, silver, and gold with the collaboration of China. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The first dry port in Pakistan was built in Lahore in _?
questions.explanation: The first dry port in Pakistan was built in Lahore in 1973. Low confidence: Lahore dry port dates vary (1973 per source). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade).

questions.text: Which of these cities is known for its sports goods production?
questions.explanation: Sialkot is the city of Pakistan known worldwide for its sports goods production. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade).

questions.text: Cottage industry is:
questions.explanation: Cottage industry refers to Handicraft — small-scale, home-based production of goods using simple tools and manual skills. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade).

questions.text: What is the largest-import item of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The largest import item of Pakistan is Petroleum, accounting for a significant portion of the country's total import bill. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade).

questions.text: What is Pakistan's largest stock exchange?
questions.explanation: Corrected key: the Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad exchanges merged into the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) in January 2016. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/industry-trade).

questions.text: What is the name of Pakistan Space Agency?
questions.explanation: The name of Pakistan's space agency is SUPARCO (Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/regulatory-bodies-national-institutions).

questions.text: When was the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) established?
questions.explanation: SUPARCO was established in 1961 as Pakistan's national space agency. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/regulatory-bodies-national-institutions).

questions.text: What is the full name of Pakistan's own satellite PRSS?
questions.explanation: The full name of Pakistan's own satellite PRSS is Pakistan Remote Sensing Satellite. Note: PRSS-1 was launched from China in July 2018. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/regulatory-bodies-national-institutions).
